file:
  win25cis_2_2_33_seimpersonateprivilege:
    title: "2.2.33 | Ensure 'Impersonate a client after authentication' is set to 'Administrators, LOCAL SERVICE, NETWORK SERVICE, SERVICE' and (when the Web Server (IIS) Role with Web Services Role Service is installed) 'IIS_IUSRS' (MS only) | SeImpersonatePrivilege"
    path: '{{ .Vars.win25cis_snapshot_dir }}\PrivilegeRights.SeImpersonatePrivilege'
    exists: true
    contents:
      - '/^S-1-5-19,S-1-5-20,S-1-5-32-544(,S-1-5-32-568)?,S-1-5-6$/'
    meta:
      memberserver: 1
      server: 1
      CIS_ID:
        - 2.2.33
      NIST800-53R5:
        - AC-2
        - AC-3
        - AC-6
        - AC-6(1)
        - AC-6(7)
        - AU-9(4)
    {{ end }}
  {{ end }}
{{ end }}

discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_2/section_2.2.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2025-CIS` and Audit control `section_2/section_2.2/cis_2.2.33.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2025-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

Applies to: Member Server only (from the upstream task name).

No runnable check (when: not win25cis_iis_and_web_services_installed); the original Ansible tasks are the fix.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.2.33 | PATCH | Ensure Impersonate a client after authentication is set to Administrators LOCAL SERVICE, NETWORK SERVICE, SERVICE and when the Web Server IIS Role with Web Services Role Service is installed IIS IUSRS MS only"
  when:
    - win25cis_rule_2_2_33
    - not prelim_win25cis_is_domain_controller
  tags:
    - level1-memberserver
    - automated
    - rule_2.2.33
    - patch
    - userrights
    - administrators
    - services
    - NIST800-171_3.1.1
    - NIST800-171_3.1.5
    - NIST800-171_3.3.8
    - NIST800-171_3.3.9
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-2
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-3
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-6
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-6_1
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-6_7
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-9_4
  block:
    - name: "2.2.33 | PATCH | Ensure Impersonate a client after authentication is set to Administrators LOCAL SERVICE, NETWORK SERVICE, SERVICE and when the Web Server IIS Role with Web Services Role Service is installed IIS IUSRS MS only | IIS not installed"
      when: not win25cis_iis_and_web_services_installed
      ansible.windows.win_user_right:
        name: SeImpersonatePrivilege
        users:
          - Administrators
          - LOCAL SERVICE
          - NETWORK SERVICE
          - SERVICE
        action: set

    - name: "2.2.33 | PATCH | Ensure Impersonate a client after authentication is set to Administrators LOCAL SERVICE, NETWORK SERVICE, SERVICE and when the Web Server IIS Role with Web Services Role Service is installed IIS IUSRS MS only | IIS installed"
      when: win25cis_iis_and_web_services_installed
      ansible.windows.win_user_right:
        name: SeImpersonatePrivilege
        users:
          - Administrators
          - IIS_IUSRS
          - LOCAL SERVICE
          - NETWORK SERVICE
          - SERVICE
        action: set
